body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: c8734b4492a81a136b66845a2dc0c39626ce407c -->
Needs changes before merge.

The command validates the text before it enters the history. The MCP tool uses that command. Placement, undo, redo and project round-trip tests pass. The new modules state their provenance. This is a partial change for #2679, so `Refs #2679` is correct.

Results merged with main, locally:

- Trial merge: `380c29b3c8406eb5e743e1dfdc258e7e35ead4b6`. The merge was clean. The PR head did not change during this review.
- Command: `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1 RUSTC_WRAPPER= cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`.
- The geometry change selected the batch plan. The run took 40.3 minutes: 948 steps, 945 passed, 3 failed.
- All nine crate prebuilds passed. `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed for all eight crates in the gate.

| Crate suites | Tests passed | Tests failed | Tests ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| geometry | 184 | 0 | 0 |
| kernel | 84 | 0 | 4 |
| cl | 69 | 0 | 0 |
| tools | 145 | 0 | 0 |
| post | 839 | 0 | 0 |
| sim | 738 | 0 | 4 |
| motion | 1207 | 0 | 22 |
| app | 3993 | 0 | 43 |
| ui | 1420 | 11 | 9 |

Feature suites: `stroke_text` passed 6 tests; `insert_text` passed 4; `mcp_dxf` passed 2; `sketch_project` passed 14. Both new font unit tests also passed.

The three failed steps were UI `lib`, `egui_app` and `shell`. Local reruns reproduced the failures. Six report tests and the library headless test could not obtain a graphics adapter:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
```

Three `egui_app` tests and one `shell` test expected exit code 0 and got 1. These tests use the same headless graphics path. The PR changes no UI code. These results limit local graphics validation; they are not attributed to this PR.

**Extra suites run**

Neither extra selection rule applies. No fixture directory, STEP fixture or importer changes. The batch fallback still ran kernel `step_agreement` (22 passed) and `machining_mesh` (7 passed).

**Safety checks and mutations**

This is a safety-tier review because it adds geometry. I repeated two mutations in the disposable review worktree:

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Remove the empty-text guard | RED: `bad_input_is_refused_by_name`, `Ok([])` instead of `Err(Empty)` |
| Remove the height guard | RED: `bad_input_is_refused_by_name`, a chaining error instead of the named height error |
| Restore both guards | GREEN: all 6 `stroke_text` tests |

No existing golden moved. I checked each line of the new inline `SN-0471` golden against the glyph coordinates and advances. No NC, CL or snapshot file changes. No toolpath or posted G-code from text was exercised.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/geometry/src/lib.rs:31` — Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Record the app and motion lane results in the PR body. The local dry run reaches every app and motion heavy target. The body says these lanes were not exercised. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, “Heavy lanes at review”, requires these results before readiness. Both lanes remain NOT RUN in this review.

Main advanced during the local run. The tested main revision is stated above. The current upstream `AGENTS.md` has no change from that revision.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
